title: Bay of Pigs bombers arrive late because of a time zone
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Bay of Pigs bombers arrive late because of a time zone, about 1961 at Bay of Pigs, Cuba / Nicaragua, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And what happened is they were in a different time zone.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, talks about the Bay of Pigs, the failed 1961 invasion of Cuba. He says the bombers meant to support the landing, linked in his telling to Anastasio Somoza and Nicaragua, arrived late because they were in a different time zone. In his account, a simple mix-up like that helped doom the operation.
